simplify: Think of this as a rule: identify the core term, apply the method step-by-step, and verify with one quick check.
Break it into three parts: concept, formula, and application. If any part is unclear, revise that before solving more questions.
Start with the definition in plain words, then connect it to one solved example from your notes.
exam-summary: Exam focus: know the definition, one standard method, and one common trap. Practice one timed question immediately.
For scoring marks, write the method cleanly, include assumptions, and end with a final check statement.
Revise keywords first, then attempt 2 past-paper questions where this concept is directly tested.
example: Example approach: pick one textbook problem, solve without notes in 3-5 steps, and compare only after finishing.
Use a mini example: define variables, apply the rule, compute, then mention why the result is valid.
Try this pattern: concept statement -> formula setup -> substitution -> final interpretation.
